desc: 3 Pieces Plastic Fridge Container With Strainer And Lid Clips For Keeping And Organizing Food, Fruits, Vegetables Set of 3 plastic fridge containers designed to help keep and organize food, fruits and vegetables inside the refrigerator in a practical way. Each container comes with a strainer and clip lid, providing a convenient way to arrange different types of foods and assemble each type into a separate container for easy access when needed. The strainer design helps separate contents from liquids at the bottom of the container depending on the type of food and method of use, while the snap lid helps secure the lid on the container during storage. The 3-piece set offers the possibility of dividing and organizing foods by type inside the refrigerator. Set of 3 containers: the set provides three separate containers that can be used to divide different types of food, fruits and vegetables, helping to arrange the contents inside the refrigerator instead of placing several items in one space. Practical internal strainer: the containers have a strainer that helps to separate the contents from the liquids collected at the bottom depending on the nature of the food, providing a practical way when storing some types of fruits and vegetables.
